limitations: Protective levels and order blocks are OHLCV proxies rather than historical book depth.
Close confirmation can realize a larger gap loss than the close threshold.
No candidate may change runtime before genuinely new forward confirmation.

mask_definitions.aligned: 168h trend, BTC 24h return and market breadth do not conflict
mask_definitions.atr: 14h ATR is at least the default 1% stop
mask_definitions.protective_swing: prior 24h directional support/resistance lies within 1.5% behind entry
mask_definitions.safe: no opposing level/block or failed directional breakout in target path
mask_definitions.supportive_ob: valid same-direction displacement block lies within 1.2% behind entry
mask_definitions.target_0_5: conditional close stop is restricted to the 0.5% target branch
mask_definitions.target_ge_1: conditional close stop is restricted to target branches at or above 1%

protocol.conditional_exit: close confirmation with hard emergency stop
